camel_example: aliyun aidge ImageTranslationPlusAsync --region cn-hangzhou --SourceLanguage zh --ImageUrl 'https://example.com/image.jpg' --TargetLanguage en --version 2026-04-28 --method POST --force
description_en: Translates e-commerce images by using the Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture. Compared with the Lite and Pro editions, the Plus edition provides higher translation accuracy for multiple minor languages
description_zh: 图片翻译Plus版产品专为电商图片设计，采用MOE架构，相比于图片翻译lite版和Pro版，在多个小语种的翻译准确性上表现更胜一筹
kebab_example: aliyun aidge image-translation-plus-async --source-language zh --target-language en --image-url https://example.com/image.jpg --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImageTranslationPlusAsync

parameters.help_en: The source language code. The value auto is supported for automatic detection
parameters.help_zh: 源语言代码；支持 auto（自动检测）
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language code. We recommend that you use the 12 minor language pairs listed above
parameters.help_zh: 目标语言代码；推荐使用上方 12 个小语种语向
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en:
Image URL: The image must be accessible over the Internet.    
Format: PNG, JPEG, JPG, BMP, or WEBP.    
Resolution: The width and height cannot exceed 4,000 pixels.   
File size: The original file size cannot exceed 10 MB
parameters.help_zh:
• 图片 URL：需公网可访问。    
• 格式：png、jpeg、jpg、bmp、webp    
• 像素： 宽和高均不超过 4000   
• 文件大小：原始文件 ≤ 10 MB
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate the text on the image subject. This helps you protect information and prevent embedded information, such as the product name, from being translated. In the example image, the text in the red box represents the text on the subject, and the text in the blue box represents the text not on the subject
parameters.help_zh:
选择是否翻译图片主体上文字；
这可以帮助您保护信息，避免翻译诸如商品名称等嵌入信息。
如示例图中，红框中的文本代表主体上文字，蓝框中的文本代表非主体上文字
parameters.name: including_product_area

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return layout information such as the position, font, and color of the text. This can be used to obtain data when you integrate the image editor for secondary editing. You can call the image translation result data query API operation to obtain the complete parameter information
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回文字的位置、字体、颜色等布局信息。可用于二次编辑接入图片编辑器时获取数据使用。您可再调用图片翻译结果数据查询接口获取完整参数信息
parameters.name: use_image_editor

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate the brand name in the image. This prevents the brand name from being translated. Default value: false. In the example image, '懒角落' represents the brand name
parameters.help_zh:
选择是否翻译图片上的品牌名。这可以帮助您保护品牌名信息，避免被翻译。
默认：false（即代表不翻译品牌名）
如示例图中，“懒角落”代表品牌名
parameters.name: translating_brand_in_the_product

parameters.help_en: The intervention glossary ID. You must create the intervention glossary separately and provide its ID in the input parameters. If the provided intervention glossary ID is empty, the translation results are not modified
parameters.help_zh:
干预词表 ID。
干预词表 ID需要单独创建，并在输入参数中提供其 ID。如果提供的干预词表 ID 为空，则翻译结果将不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en: The business order ID of the caller. This ID is recorded when the request is accepted and returned as is when you query the asynchronous task result
parameters.help_zh: 调用方业务单号，受理时记录并在查询异步任务结果时原样返回
parameters.name: biz_id

Code.description_en: The response code for the submission call. A successful call returns success
Code.description_zh: 提交调用响应代码；成功示例为 success
Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

Data.description_en: The submission result of the asynchronous task for the Plus edition of image translation
Data.description_zh: 图片翻译 Plus 异步任务提交结果

TaskId.description_en: The identifier of the asynchronous task, which is used for result queries and notification association. Do not use the example prefix as a business validation rule
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务标识，用于结果查询和通知关联；不以示例前缀作为业务校验规则
TaskId.title_en: 用于查询异步任务结果的任务 ID
TaskId.title_zh: 用于查询异步任务结果的任务 ID

Data.title_en: 图片翻译 Plus 异步任务提交结果
Data.title_zh: 图片翻译 Plus 异步任务提交结果

Message.description_en: The error message, such as 'The content contains sensitive data. Try another input.'
Message.description_zh: 报错信息，例如“内容包含敏感数据，请尝试其他输入”
Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which is used for troubleshooting and tracing analysis
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求唯一标识，用于问题排查与链路追踪

Success.description_en: Specifies whether the submission call is successful. This does not indicate that the translation is complete. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 提交调用是否成功，不代表翻译已完成。；true 代表成功，false 代表失败
